traceability.visible_claim: Loopback browser and CLI enter one local FastAPI/shared Runtime boundary.
SQLAlchemy/SQLite plus Alembic and ignored local raw/source/export files form the persistence boundary.
Docker Compose publishes loopback only and persists /app/var in a named volume under a read-only-rootfs profile.
The optional web-discovery/capture/model boundary is implemented but a live public-company execution is not claimed.
Direct Companies House and UKRI live registry adapters remain G2-held.
Remote exposure, multi-user auth/tenancy, cloud deployment, autonomous publication and production-security assurance are non-goals.

limitations: The exhibit is an architecture/status synthesis, not an empirical result or evidence of benefit, accuracy, cost, scale or user utility.
Local tests and a healthy loopback container do not establish production security, multi-user isolation, cloud readiness, source-law compliance or external validity.
The recorded Docker runtime check is time-specific and makes no claim that a research stage or external call occurred.
The implemented optional public-research path has fake, synthetic and adversarial engineering evidence; no completed live public-company execution or live-result quality claim is admitted here.
Direct registry connector implementation or synthetic replay does not grant live permission; current source-admission status remains binding.
Hashes support integrity and traceability, not source truth, authority, encryption, anonymisation, legal permission or ethical approval.
No PDF tagging is claimed; use the complete TXT alternative for accessible reading order and detail.
